final_claim.narrative: A temporal reachability query constrained to max_wait=600 found no time-respecting route from 1085 to 639 in [21277,59677] (step_01). An unconstrained query does find a route via node 1141 but the inter-event wait is 20146 time units (step_02), far exceeding the 600 limit. Therefore a genuine cascade under the 600-unit forwarding constraint is absent.
